name: 5-fluoro-DET
summary: 5-Fluoro-DET, or 5-F-DET, also known as 5-fluoro-N,N-diethyltryptamine, is a tryptamine derivative related to drugs such as diethyltryptamine (DET) and 5-MeO-DET. It is known to act as an inhibitor of the enzyme myeloperoxidase, and is also thought to be an agonist at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.

pharmacology.text: It is known to act as an inhibitor of the enzyme myeloperoxidase, and is also thought to be an agonist at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.

summaryZh: 5-F-DET是一種有機化合物，化學式為C14H19FN2。它被認作是一種5-HT2A受體的激動劑。它可由甲磺酸-5-氟吲哚-3-乙酯和二乙胺反應製得。
summaryZhHans: 5-F-DET是一种有机化合物，化学式为C14H19FN2。它被认作是一种5-HT2A受体的激动剂。它可由甲磺酸-5-氟吲哚-3-乙酯和二乙胺反应制得。

uses.en: It is a research compound, studied both for its action on serotonin receptors and as an enzyme blocker.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，研究方向包括它對血清素受體的作用，以及它作為酵素抑制劑的性質。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，研究方向包括它对血清素受体的作用，以及它作为酵素抑制剂的性质。

fact.en: Besides acting on serotonin receptors, it blocks myeloperoxidase, an enzyme white blood cells use to make bleach-like chemicals to kill bacteria.
fact.zh: 除了作用於血清素受體之外，它還會抑制髓過氧化酶；白血球會用這種酵素製造類似漂白劑的化學物質來殺菌。
fact.zhHans: 除了作用于血清素受体之外，它还会抑制髓过氧化酶；白血球会用这种酵素制造类似漂白剂的化学物质来杀菌。
